text:
Maya (Recruiter): Hey team – candidate accepted verbally (Sr PM) but needs to start 2 weeks earlier than our standard benefits eligibility date. Hiring team asking for a one-time comp band top-up to match counter. Can we route?
Sam Chen: He’s on H-1B transfer timeline, needs earliest payroll start or they’ll lose offer. Counteroffer is +8% base and prorated signon to cover lost benefits months.
Maya (Recruiter): Offer in Greenhouse, comp band is Level 5. Requesting a one-off top-up to effectively move to top of band for first 6 months then revert. Also asking benefits to start day 1 or pro-rate medical premium coverage.
Taylor (People Ops): Thanks — flagging two things: (1) comp exception approval (Comp & Rewards signoff) and (2) benefits eligibility / waiting period exception (Benefits team + Finance for cost). Need explicit business justification.
Maya (Recruiter): Filing justification: critical hire, high retention risk if start delayed, visa timing risk. Attaching candidate comms + competing offer snippet.
Luis - TotalComp: Can you paste the current comp table row and proposed numbers? need to calc impact on comp run rate.
Maya (Recruiter): Proposed: base 8% above midpoint = $160k -> $172.8k for first 6 months then revert. One-time sign-on $7k to offset premiums.
Priya (Finance): Payroll/benefits note: benefits change mid-cycle affects billing. If benefits start day 1 we’ll need cost estimate and headcount budget owner approval. Also need effective payroll start date for tax withholding.
Taylor (People Ops): OK. Routing checklist: 1) Comp exception form -> Comp & Rewards (Luis) 2) Benefits waiver request -> Benefits lead 3) Budget owner approval -> Finance (Priya) 4) Final sign-off from People Ops director. Please attach Greenhouse offer and candidate email.
Maya (Recruiter): Done. Attached GH offer link: https://greenhouse.example/r/ABC123 and quote from candidate.
Offer Approvals Bot: Approval flow started for thread 1769991234. Approvers queued: Luis - TotalComp, Priya (Finance), Taylor (People Ops Director).
Luis - TotalComp: Reviewed the math. Impact is within a one-time threshold but needs Director sign-off. Approve on comp grounds conditional on documented revert. :white_check_mark:
Priya (Finance): Finance can approve the pro-rated benefits effective date to be Day 1 if budget owner signs off and payroll confirms in Workday. Asking Sam to confirm budget owner and effective payroll date.
Sam Chen: Budget owner is Product Line Lead, Jess Navarro. Payroll date earliest 2026-04-01 (pay period alignment). Will ping Jess now.
Maya (Recruiter): Jess replied in DM: approves the one-time top-up and day 1 benefits for this critical hire.
Taylor (People Ops): Good. I’ll queue the benefits waiver and comp exception for final director signoff. Please leave the candidate on hold for official confirmation until approvals complete.
Offer Approvals Bot: Luis - TotalComp approved at 1769991305. Priya (Finance) approved at 1769991322 pending Workday change. Taylor (People Ops Director) requested minor language on reversion timing.
Taylor (People Ops): Final note: comp top-up will be time-limited 6 months and will explicitly revert on next compensation cycle; offer letter addendum required. I’ll edit the offer and circulate for e-signature once Workday entry is scheduled.
Maya (Recruiter): Thank you all — will pause verbal confirmation until addendum is uploaded. :pray:
Sam Chen: Appreciate the fast turn. One more ask: confirm benefits start date in the offer addendum text exactly as Payroll expects.
Priya (Finance): We’ll confirm the exact date after Workday entry. Finance will send the cost estimate to hiring lead and People Ops.
Taylor (People Ops): Closing checklist: addendum drafted, Workday entry scheduled, approvals logged. Closing thread when signed. :white_check_mark:
